records.source_paraphrase: A body chapter titled Males de Nascença says definitive life-length determination should not be made until age 24; contrasts Bhasin/Jātaka source caution under age 12.
records.critical_limit: Not a medical or actuarial guideline; conflicting 12/24 boundaries are separate transmitted versions, not performance estimates.

records.source_paraphrase: The text introduces planetary Ishta and Kashta benefic/malefic strength as modifiers for Daśā effects, a source section absent from the translator's TOC.
records.critical_limit: Determining quantitative strengths requires exact algorithm, not simply retrograde/dignity labels.

records.source_paraphrase: A body-only chapter on Padas das casas specifies computing Arudha Padas by counting a house to its lord and repeating from lord, not limited to Upapada.
records.critical_limit: Cannot equate with Rath's competing Arudha longitude conventions; sign counting and exceptions need freeze.

records.source_paraphrase: The text contains a separate numbered Argala/planetary intervention chapter omitted from the TOC between Upapada and Karakatwa.
records.critical_limit: Overlaps Jaimini translated sutras but not independent forecast evidence.

records.source_paraphrase: The missing Yoga da Lua section differentiates Moon in angular, succedent or cadent relation to Sun and modifies day/night cases with D9 aspects.
records.critical_limit: Moon relation to Sun is correlated with lunar phase; separate local house/D9 and actual outcome target definitions.

records.source_paraphrase: Sudarshana Chakra appears as its own numbered chapter yet is not included in the TOC. It explicitly restricts its three-ring method when two reference signs coincide, and compares Ashtakavarga results.
records.critical_limit: Prior B20 already recorded this actual method; B27 records the new omission/structural provenance, not an independent duplicate success.

records.source_paraphrase: Women’s horoscope chapter is present in the body but absent from TOC; source directs some natal results to woman, some to husband and certain topics to seventh/eighth house.
records.critical_limit: Do not switch person predicted post hoc or infer partner death/sexual health. Historical androcentric premises remain source history.

records.source_paraphrase: Between opening female-horoscope verses and subsequent clauses, the Portuguese compilation explicitly inserts quotations labeled Brihat Jatak, Phaldeepika de Mantreswara, and Jatakpari Jata.
records.critical_limit: These paragraphs are imported quotations, not independent original Parashara verse nor three empirical predictions.

records.source_paraphrase: One translated line associates a malefic in seventh and another in eighth with a woman entering an ascetic life, besides sensitive partner-mortality assertions.
records.critical_limit: Even observable initiation needs cultural/consent safeguards; do not infer personal partner mortality or moral status.

records.source_paraphrase: A numbered women’s physical-characteristics chapter cites Shiva-to-Parvati teaching and links marks on feet/body to royal standing or poverty.
records.critical_limit: Uses sensory examination of physical marks outside natal sky; gender/social discrimination and no causal evidence.

records.source_paraphrase: A mark/mole/whorl on one side of the body is interpreted differently for men and women and linked to supposed material or marital fortune.
records.critical_limit: Requires intimate visual inputs, not DOB/time; do not solicit sensitive body pictures or profile absent people.

records.source_paraphrase: A chapter explicitly invokes alleged curses from serpent, father, mother, brother or priest from past lives to explain fertility/offspring setbacks.
records.critical_limit: Religious explanatory claim is not a causal medical diagnosis; avoid blaming infertile people and avoid promising rituals change pregnancy outcomes.

records.source_paraphrase: A numbered chapter absent from TOC assigns colors/materials and ritual representations to nine planets and claims improved peace, health and prosperity from propitiation.
records.critical_limit: Intervention/ritual instructions are not chart prediction or proven medical treatment; no efficacy evidence in source.

records.source_paraphrase: Text explicitly says births can be judged unfavorable despite well-placed planets when tithi, sibling/parent nakshatra, ingress, eclipses or Gandanta conditions occur.
records.critical_limit: Source-specified override introduces historical lunisolar calendar, event timing and family-nakshatra inputs; no validated harm implication.

records.source_paraphrase: The text partitions Krishna Chaturdashi into six intervals with different allegedly adverse outcomes assigned to relatives, losses or native.
records.critical_limit: Astronomical interval calculation and verified exact time needed; morally and medically unsafe personal-family danger claims.

records.source_paraphrase: The text distinguishes Tithi Gandanta, Nakshatra Gandanta and Ascendant Gandanta with particular boundary intervals and a special Abhukta Mula subset.
records.critical_limit: Different astronomical variables and ghatika units; none is evidence of medical mortality or inherited evil. Do not equate with D9 uncertainty.

records.source_paraphrase: The compiler includes a marked Note recommending a specialist priest for the efficacy of rituals, separate from attributed original wording.
records.critical_limit: The note's claim that specialized ritual eliminates harms is untested and not an ancient astronomical algorithm.

records.source_paraphrase: The text asserts severe misfortune for certain birth-nakshatra boundaries and reports a practice of abandoning or avoiding a child; also gives a conditional exception if a predicted affected in-law does not exist.
records.critical_limit: Child abandonment is harmful; this is documentation, NOT an endorsement or personal forecast. Source exception should be preserved only to analyze internal logic.

records.source_paraphrase: A separate chapter calls a daughter after three sons or a son after three daughters a family curse requiring ritual mitigation.
records.critical_limit: Sex-based stigmatization is not fact or medical advice. Family birth order is external factual input rather than natal planetary features.

records.source_paraphrase: A chapter labels congenital differences, prematurity and certain animal births as inauspicious and instructs ostracism of mothers/animals.
records.critical_limit: Harmful stigma and abandonment must never be recommended; no validated prognostic/medical content.

caveats: These 20 entries are historical documentary claims, not 20 independent real-world prediction successes.
Ritual and gender/disability/family-status assertions have serious stigma potential; do not use as advice or person-specific profiling.
Translator's embedded imports are not Parashara's original ancient Sanskrit; original recension not established.
Some computational source variants are beyond birth-only sky data and remain unimplemented.
